title: DINGO: gravitational-wave parameters in seconds
summary: The neural network estimates the mass, spin, position, inclination and distance of binary black holes in seconds rather than hours or months, with about ten days of training, and was tested on eight events from LIGO and Virgo’s O1 and O2 runs. Published in Physical Review Letters; extension to neutron stars is only promising; source reviewed was a Max Planck doctoral-program page.
organization: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics
